thread:
arya: PM asked for a lightweight 'what-if routing simulator' in the console: pick a route mix, flip x% traffic to a cheaper model variant, and get an instant cost + latency delta with uncertainty. Wanted quick feasibility call.
sam: sounds useful. minimal inputs: baseline traffic (") estimate per-route token/sec, seq_len histogram, current cache hit rate, and model per-token unit price. we already have model price table.
dave: main constraint: our telemetry is sampled and sharded; per-route seq_len histogram at 1m is tricky. we can emit aggregated histograms from the router with 5 coarse buckets. that keeps cardinality low.
ida: agree. propose emitter schema: metric names: router.tokens[model,route], router.cache_hits[model,route], router.latency_p50[route], router.latency_p95[route]. resolution: 1m rollups, retention 7d. auth: only console-service role can read full model+route aggregates.
ux-jo: UX idea: small compact panel on route page with two controls: 1) reroute slider (0-100%) to cheaper variant, 2) toggle prefetch on/off. show three numbers: predicted_cost_delta, predicted_latency_delta, confidence_band. clickable "explain" lists main drivers.
arya: API sketch: POST /internal/simulate/whatif with body: model, alt_model, route, reroute_pct, window_minutes, seq_len_buckets_override?, cache_override?. return: predicted_cost_delta, predicted_latency_delta, predicted_tokens, ci. (Prefer JSON-only contract.)
sam: implement MV approach: compute materialized view per (model,route,minute) that has token_count, weighted_seq_hist, cache_hits, p50,p95. simulation job can pull last-N minutes and scale. MV update every 2m.
dave: storage note: do not index by tenant; only store model+route+env to avoid cardinality explosion. tenant-level impacts should be approximated by sampling or per-tenant coarse counters.
ida: security note: simulation results are approximations and could leak usage patterns if shown to non-admins. gate the console button to org_admins and the beta flag. also redact exact token counts for orgs unless they own the org.
ux-jo: small UX twist: add preset buttons for common scenarios: "shift 20% to small-quant", "enable prefetch". each preset shows recommended canary settings (percent & evaluation window).
arya: rollout plan: alpha to infra + platform for 2 weeks, compute sim_error daily (abs(pred - actual) / actual) per-model. if median error > 25% we pause beta.
sam: perf estimate: MV pipeline + simple simulator service + console widget. 2 engineers, ~6 weeks. cheaper MVP: use last-5m aggregated counters on demand without persistent MV, 2-3 weeks but less accurate.
dave: impl detail: for seq_len histograms use fixed buckets: [0-32,33-128,129-512,513-2048,>2048]. store bucket fractions as floats. cache credits: model-level prefetch factor applied multiplicatively.
ida: monitoring: emit sim_request_total, sim_latency_ms, sim_error_histogram. store predicted vs actual drift for 30d.
ux-jo: front-end: show tiny chart of predicted vs actual for previous runs, so PMs can eyeball drift. also expose a CTA "apply to canary" that pre-fills rollout wizard.
ops-bot: created ticket WF-2468 assigned to sam/dave. CI job queued. :gear:
arya: thanks all. @sam @dave can you post proto for emitter + example payload/response by EOD? I'll sync with PM on scoping and beta org list. :thumbsup:
